segments.text: The protagonist. Favorite phrase: economically sound. Seirin Academy Class 3-C. Years ago, his parents abandoned him and his little sister, leaving them with little money to their names. Unable to rely on any relatives, they live alone. In order to give his sister a comfortable life, he works several part-time jobs. He only relies on two things: his sister and his money. However, as long as money is involved, he'll work diligently and earnestly to earn his keep. When he's on the job, he slicks back his gloomy bangs to disguise himself. Thus, when he meets Emi to fulfill her rental request, she doesn't even realize that he's her classmate.
From NekoNyan
本作主人公、好きな言葉『損得勘定』。
清凜学院3年C組。数年前に雀の涙ほどのお金とマンションの一室を残し両親が失踪、頼れる親戚もなく、妹と二人暮らしをしている。妹を不自由なく養うため、学生をしながらも数多のバイトをしていた。妹とお金以外を信用していないが、金銭が絡むと、対価として望まれるだけの働きを真摯に遂行する。
バイト中は鬱陶しいほど伸びた前髪をオールバックにして変装し、知り合いとの接触をなるべく避けている。そのため、レンタルバイトを通して会うことになる絵未に、クラスメイトだと気付かれていない。

The protagonist's classmate in Class 3-C of Seirin Academy. Provided his first rental request. She's part of a group of popular girls and often sits on his desk when chatting with friends. Only ever talks to him when he asks her to get off his desk. She's actually the type who doesn't consider the consequences of her actions, so she makes a habit of showing off at the slightest instigation. Though, she also works hard so that her peers don't leave her behind. She and Hasumi are childhood friends. She loves karaoke and staying active.
From NekoNyan
清凜学園３年C組、最初にレンタルの依頼をしてきたクラスメイト。
クラスの中では人気のある女子グループに属している。よく友達と談笑するのに主人公の机に座っていて、退いてもらう時くらいしか話したことはない。実は後先考えないタイプで、おだてられたりするとつい見栄を張ってしまう癖がある。周りに置いてかれないように日々頑張っている影の努力家でもある。 クラスメイトの八純とは幼馴染みで、仲が良い。身体を動かすことと、カラオケが好き。

She has the looks and personality of a friendly honor student and is quite popular as a result. Due to her curiosity, lack of fear, and perhaps her somewhat spoiled upbringing, her tastes are a little different than most girls her age. She has a characteristic "nyuhuhu" laugh that the protagonist finds unsettling. Loves to eat. Her favorite foods are cheese, ramen, and cheese ramen. She's starting to get a little concerned about her weight. When she runs into the protagonist on the street late one night, she asks him to be her friend.
From NekoNyan
絵未のクラスメイトで幼馴染み。
優等生な見た目と性格をしていて、誰からも好かれるような人当たりの良さで人気がある。
かなり好奇心旺盛かつ怖いもの知らずであり、ちょっとしたお嬢様なせいか、趣味趣向が普通の女の子とズレている。 にゅふふ、と主人公曰く気色悪い笑みを浮かべる。食べることが好きで、特にチーズとラーメンが大好き。最近、ちょっとお腹周りが気になり始めた。
夜の街でばったり出くわした主人公に、友達になって欲しいとお願いする。

Yukyu Academy Class 1-2. She's the older, more fidgety twin. In contrast to her little sister, she's strong-willed and hates losing. An archetypal tsuntsun girl. Perhaps due to her little sister's airheadedness, she's taken up the role of a level-headed older sister. Deep down, she wants to be babied, but due to her baby sister's antics and her own disastrous true nature, her desires can never be fulfilled. She attends the same prep school as the protagonist.
From NekoNyan
悠丘学園1年2組。双子の姉で、妹よりちょっとだけ桃尻。
妹とは対照的に気が強く、負けず嫌い。典型的ツンツンタイプ。妹がちょっと抜けているせいもあってか、しっかりお姉ちゃん役をやっている苦労人。本当は極度の甘えたがりなのだが、妹がアレなのと、本人の性格が災いし、欲求を満たせずにいる。 主人公と同じ予備校に通っている。

Yukyu Academy Class 1-2. She's the younger, more laid-back twin. It's hard to understand what she's thinking, but for some reason, she always seems extremely sensual. She doesn't care for her appearance, so Chinatsu has to mind it instead. She's sensitive to the cold and wears thick clothes even in the middle of summer. Secretly a horny pervert who's usually thinking something dirty when she's quiet. And she's usually quiet. A quick learner, but can seem a little slow at times.
From NekoNyan
悠丘学園1年2組。双子の妹で、姉とは違い、かなり落ち着いている。
何を考えているかわかりづらく、仕草や雰囲気がどことなくエロい。 身なりに無頓着なので、ちなつが気をかけている。極度の冷え性で真夏でも厚着している。実はドの付く変態で、黙っている時はだいたいろくでもないことを妄想している。勉強をはじめ、なんでもそつなくこなすが、ちょっと鈍臭いところがある。

Lecturer at the prep school the protagonist attends. A sleek, mature lady. Her slender figure looks beautiful in her suit. But when she gets home, she changes into a tracksuit, slurps cup noodles, and lives the lonely gamer life, staying up late into the night. Back in her hometown, she was super serious, and thus never got any experience with men. Fed up with the meddling of her worried parents and family, she pretends that she's been playing the field and simply isn't ready to settle down yet. However, once her parents send her cousin to check up on her, she gets desperate and asks the protagonist to play the role of a paramour.
From NekoNyan
主人公たちが通う予備校の講師。
スーツを着こなし、美人でスタイルも良く、ちょっぴりクールな大人のレディ。
家に帰るとジャージ姿でカップメンを啜り、徹夜でゲームする悲しい独身ゲーマーに早変わる。地元にいるときはずっと真面目ちゃんで、社会に出てからも男っ気がまったくなかった。心配になった両親や親戚たちがお節介を焼いてくるようになり、適当に遊んでいると誤魔化していた。しかし、偵察として従姉が派遣されることになり、苦渋の選択として主人公に愛人役を頼むことになる。

She looks and acts like a cutesy gyaru, so everyone assumes she's a skank. Her short stature ensures she always looks at you with upturned eyes, which is the cutest thing about her. Or at least, that's what she claims. She apparently gets confessed to once a week, but currently has no boyfriend.
From NekoNyan

Segawa Emi and Tenma Hasumi's classmate. Has tomboyish tastes, perhaps due to her brothers, who are much older than her. She always seems to be on top of things and lives for teasing Emi and Mihama Saki. Always up for some antics, and will generally join in if invited to do something. She's also known to drag others along for the ride with her. Loves Hasumi and can even identify the shampoo she usually uses by scent alone.
From NekoNyan
She became Shinkai Yuki's girlfriend in Youka Nanoka's short story Momoko After - PeachFlash.
絵未と八純のクラスメイト。
上に歳の離れた兄が二人いるせいか、趣味が男の子寄り。いつも余裕のある態度で、絵未や咲希をいじって遊ぶのが生きがい。ノリが良く、誘えばだいたいなんでも付き合ってくれる。逆に強制連行されるなんてことも。八純が大好きで、普段使っているシャンプーの銘柄まで把握している。

First-year student at Yukyu Academy and classmate of the Izumi sisters. Calls the protagonist Brother. Due to her puppy-like nature, she's so cute that everyone wants to pat her on the head. Bright and energetic. When she gets competitive with Chinatsu, she tries to act sneaky, but it never works out because she's easy to read. Loves her real brother and always brags about him to Chinatsu.
From NekoNyan
悠丘学園1年、泉姉妹のクラスメイトで、主人公のことをブラザーと呼ぶ。
ワンコのような性格で、つい頭を撫でたくなるような愛らしさがある。性格も明るく活発。ちなつと張り合う時だけ、ちょっと狡いことをしたりするが、全部顔に出る。

Yumeno's brother. Tall, broad-shouldered, and silent. Attends Eikou University Preparatory Academy. Due to his low-energy nature and ridiculously huge build, many people call him a bear upon first meeting him. Apart from his bluntness, he's a very nice, agreeable guy. He's also a gentle older brother who more or less humors Yumeno's antics. He immediately hits it off with the protagonist as a fellow older brother, and they become friends.
From NekoNyan
夢乃のお兄ちゃん。
高身長で肩幅広く、絵に描いたような朴念仁。永光付属に通う。
素のテンションが低く、無駄にがたいがいいので、初対面の人間によくクマのようだと言われる。 無愛想なことを除けば、とってもいい奴なので付き合いも良く、夢乃の無茶ぶりにも一応付き合ってはくれる優しい兄貴。 主人公とは初対面で同じお兄ちゃん同士意気投合し、仲良しになる。

Tsubaki's older cousin. Owner of the restaurant "Sunny and Lettuce" where the protagonist, Emi, and Konatsu work. She enjoys messing with young maidens in love. And Tsubaki, too. Things get annoying whenever she's involved. Tsubaki's parents asked her to keep an eye on her private life, and she wholeheartedly agreed. People around her think she's an alcoholic, since she's always drunk and all.
From NekoNyan
椿の従姉。主人公と絵未、こなつがバイトしているレストラン『サニー＆レタス』のオーナー。
恋に悩むうら若き乙女や椿をからかうのが趣味みたいなところがあり、絡まれると面倒くさい。 椿の両親に頼まれ、ノリノリで引き受け、彼女の私生活を監視することになる。 常にお酒を飲んでいて、周りからアル中だと思われている。

The protagonist's little sister. Due to family circumstances, she's mature for her age and is quite assertive. While she respects her older brother, she doesn't want him to keep overexerting himself for her sake, so she firmly objects whenever he does something wrong. Though she acts her age on rare occasions, she always has her guard up. Lately, she's started to think her brother is acting gloomy, which the protagonist perceives as a sign of her having reached her rebellious age.
From NekoNyan
主人公の妹。
境遇からか、歳の割には思考が成熟しており、しっかりと自分の意志を持っている。兄のことを敬愛しているが、これ以上自分のためだけに尽くすのを良しとせず、また悪いことや間違っていることに対しては、はっきりと物申す。 一方で、歳相応な面もあるが、それでもごく稀にしか見せないガードの堅い妹。しかし近頃、兄が鬱陶しく感じることがあり、主人公に反抗期の到来を予感させている。
